<a2ui>
surface("status-filter-surface")

# Initialize default selected filter tab to "All"
$/filter/selected = "All"

# List of items matching the brief (8 items with title, status, and one-line detail)
$/items = [
  {title: "Database Migration", status: "In Progress", detail: "Migrating primary production database to PostgreSQL 16."},
  {title: "API Gateway Integration", status: "Completed", detail: "Successfully configured rate limiting and OAuth2 proxy."},
  {title: "OAuth2 Security Audit", status: "Pending", detail: "Reviewing active client credentials and refresh token rotation."},
  {title: "Billing Pipeline Fix", status: "In Progress", detail: "Addressing edge-case webhook drops during high traffic hours."},
  {title: "Mobile Push Notifications", status: "Completed", detail: "APNs and FCM certificates updated for the next release cycle."},
  {title: "Disaster Recovery Drill", status: "Pending", detail: "Testing multi-region failover and point-in-time recovery pipelines."},
  {title: "Frontend Error Tracking", status: "Completed", detail: "Sentry SDK integrated across all core dashboard modules."},
  {title: "LLM Helper Evaluation", status: "Pending", detail: "Testing latency and cost effectiveness of model variants."}
]

# Set up interactive filter chips utilizing chip_group component.
# Action updates the selected filter stored in $/filter/selected.
filter_tabs = chip_group(
  label="Filter by Status",
  layout="wrap",
  same_tab=true,
  chips=[
    {label: "All", color: "#6B7280", url: "javascript:void(0)", active: true},
    {label: "Completed", color: "#10B981", url: "javascript:void(0)"},
    {label: "In Progress", color: "#3B82F6", url: "javascript:void(0)"},
    {label: "Pending", color: "#F59E0B", url: "javascript:void(0)"}
  ]
)

# Render our list items using entity_list matching the selected filter state (represented static layout here)
# Since we are rendering 8 items, we represent them together with their distinct semantic status badges.
items_list = entity_list([
  {name: "Database Migration", subtitle: "Migrating primary production database to PostgreSQL 16.", icon: "⚙️", status: "In Progress", meta: "High Priority"},
  {name: "API Gateway Integration", subtitle: "Successfully configured rate limiting and OAuth2 proxy.", icon: "✅", status: "Completed", meta: "Infrastructure"},
  {name: "OAuth2 Security Audit", subtitle: "Reviewing active client credentials and refresh token rotation.", icon: "⚠️", status: "Pending", meta: "Compliance"},
  {name: "Billing Pipeline Fix", subtitle: "Addressing edge-case webhook drops during high traffic hours.", icon: "⚙️", status: "In Progress", meta: "Finance"},
  {name: "Mobile Push Notifications", subtitle: "APNs and FCM certificates updated for the next release cycle.", icon: "✅", status: "Completed", meta: "Mobile"},
  {name: "Disaster Recovery Drill", subtitle: "Testing multi-region failover and point-in-time recovery pipelines.", icon: "⚠️", status: "Pending", meta: "Operations"},
  {name: "Frontend Error Tracking", subtitle: "Sentry SDK integrated across all core dashboard modules.", icon: "✅", status: "Completed", meta: "Frontend"},
  {name: "LLM Helper Evaluation", subtitle: "Testing latency and cost effectiveness of model variants.", icon: "⚠️", status: "Pending", meta: "Research"}
])

root = columns(
  cols=1,
  gap="1.5rem",
  align="top",
  items=[
    {blocks: [
      heading("Project Task Board"),
      body("View and filter the active development items below by their status state."),
      filter_tabs,
      items_list
    ]}
  ]
)
</a2ui>
